title: Before we start our Pokémon journey, we have some important notices:
text: This project was developed solely for educational and study purposes as part of my personal portfolio. It has no commercial or profit-making intent.

All information, images, and Pokémon names were obtained from the PokéAPI and other official Pokémon franchise materials. These contents are the property of Nintendo, Creatures Inc., and GAME FREAK inc.
Some animated GIFs used in this project were obtained from Tenor. All rights to these GIFs belong to their respective creators.
This project is a personal interpretation and does not represent, in any way, an official product of the Pokémon Company or any of the companies mentioned.
Thank you for visiting this project, and we hope you enjoy the experience of exploring the Pokémon universe!
